name: Apartment Laura Lorenz
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Apartment Laura Lorenz is a self-catering apartment located in Galtür in the Paznaun valley. The accommodation is situated at the edge of the village and offers a peaceful setting. The apartment is designed for two to four people and features a fully equipped kitchen, a bedroom, and a bathroom. A balcony with a view of the mountainous landscape is included. In summer, the area is perfect for hiking and mountain biking, while in winter, the nearby Silvretta Montafon ski resort is within reach. Guests use the apartment as a base for exploring the region. The furnishings are practical and tailored to the needs of self-sufficient travelers.
